questions.Description:
Determine the Rockwell hardness or Brinell hardness number for various materials such as HSS, mild steel, copper and aluminium (Any Two).
Compare the results to identify the hardest material

Determine the impact energy and specific impact fact or for ductile
Materials by (i) Charpy Impact test and (ii) Izod impact test.

Conduct a tensile test for a ductile material and determine the following;
i) Ultimate tensile stress. ii) Yield stress. iii) Breaking stress. iv) % Elongation v) Young's   modulus. vi) % Reduction in area.
Determine ultimate shear strength in single shear for a ductile material.
Determine ultimate shear strength in double shear for a ductile material.
Determine the modulus of rigidity of the material of the open coil spring.
Determine the modulus of rigidity of the material of the Closed coil spring.
Prepare and mount the specimen (Ferrous or Non-ferrous material) and Check the microstructure of the given specimens by using a metallurgical microscope.
Determine the behavior of Mild steel when subjected to Torsion and  calculate the following torsional properties: (1) Modulus of rigidity (2) Elastic shear strength.
Detect the surface or subsurface crack of the given ferromagnetic material Using dye penetration test and magnetic particle test
